title: New feature in my restaurant: delivery system 🥲q
author: PuzzleheadedBlood184
selftext:
Hey everyone, as some of you know, I am building my game from scratch in 3 months. I have a $200 laptop and no money or friends, so I just lock in and work 😂

This week I made the delivery system for the restaurant. It is a feature you unlock in the restaurant part of the game. Then you need to hire all the delivery employees. When you hire the last one, a cinematic cutscene plays, and that is what you see in the video.  
The restaurant is the day side of the game, and at night you are a contract kill\*r. I try to keep both sides connected so it doesn't feel like two different games.

As always, my laptop can't run a screen recorder without crashing, so I filmed the screen with my phone 🥲 Sorry if it looks shaky.

Ask me anything about the game or my life, or let me know your thoughts guys 🫶🏼
